top_signals.title: Oil Producers, Buyers Looking at Long-Term Alternatives to Hormuz, Says Clara Gillispie
top_signals.summary: Clara Gillispie, senior fellow for climate and energy  at the Council on Foreign Relations, said that both oil producers and buyers are now considering the possibility that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed or operating at a reduced capacity a year in the future. Gillispie said that as countries look for workarounds to the Strait, they are looking both alternative routes and ways to decrease their insurance risk exposure.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
